page_title: MAR 1-0 MON | Marseille v Monaco 14/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The ball is out of play. Marseille will have a throw-in.
90+2' Mohammed Salisu (Monaco) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
90+1' Monaco have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.

90' Mika Biereth (Monaco) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the bottom right corner that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance. The ball is out of play. Monaco win a corner kick.
90' George Ilenikhena (Monaco) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for Geronimo Rulli as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
90' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Monaco, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
89' Monaco enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
86' Mika Biereth (Monaco) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Takumi Minamino.
86' Substitution. George Ilenikhena (Monaco) in, Lamine Camara out.
86' Here is a change. Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang is going off and Roberto De Zerbi gives the last tactical orders to Darryl Bakola (Marseille).
83' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) is shown a yellow card by the referee.

82' 1 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Mason Greenwood (Marseille), who beats Lukas Hradecky with a brilliant shot into the top of the net. 1:0.
81' Arthur Vermeeren will be replaced by Bilal Nadir (Marseille).
81' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Monaco due to an offside in the build-up play.
81' The Monaco players halt their celebrations as referee Francois Letexier makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
80' GOAL! Folarin Balogun (Monaco) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Geronimo Rulli, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 0:0.
77' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block.

74' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the right side of the goal. It's a great effort but an even better save from Geronimo Rulli, who tips the ball around the post.
73' So close! Matt O'Riley (Marseille) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
73' That will be all from Aleksandr Golovin who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jordan Teze (Monaco).
71' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Lukas Hradecky is alert and denies him.

69' Lukas Hradecky was forced into action to thwart Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille). He found himself some space after picking up a pass and unleashed a shot to the left post but couldn't beat the keeper.
69' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.

68' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
68' Marseille take a short corner kick.

66' Arthur Vermeeren (Marseille) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
65' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Marseille, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
64' Francois Letexier shows a yellow card to Vanderson (Monaco) for his blatant foul.
64' The corner is swung in but Monaco can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
62' Monaco string together a series of short passes.
60' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
59' A weak shot from the edge of the box by Igor Paixao (Marseille) is easily saved by Lukas Hradecky.
58' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to make a change. Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) replaces Michael Murillo.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Benjamin Pavard trots off the pitch and is replaced by Igor Paixao (Marseille).
58' Matt O'Riley (Marseille) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
53' Lamine Camara (Monaco) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

53' Lamine Camara (Monaco) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. Good work from Monaco as they win a corner.
52' Lamine Camara (Monaco) has a goal ruled out for offside!
48' Monaco can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
48' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes behind for a corner. Monaco will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

46' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.
46' The whistle blows and Francois Letexier starts the second half.
46' Roberto De Zerbi has made a change at the break. Matt O'Riley (Marseille) has come on in place of Geoffrey Kondogbia.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' The goalkeeper is not tested by the free kick from the edge of the box by Lamine Camara (Monaco) as his effort only hit the wall.

45+1' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Francois Letexier blows his whistle for a foul. Monaco win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) causes Geronimo Rulli little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
43' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) connects with an accurate pass inside the box and fires the ball to the bottom right corner, but one of the defending players steps in to block the effort.

42' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) makes contact with a cross but fails to connect perfectly. His low drive heads straight towards the middle of the goal where the goalkeeper makes a decent save to deny him.
40' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) was quite harsh and Francois Letexier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
38' The Monaco players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
35' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Monaco comes to nothing.
34' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Monaco will take a corner kick.
33' Monaco take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
32' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Monaco get a corner.
31' Monaco fail to score from a corner as Geronimo Rulli (Marseille) leaps to collect the ball.
30' Looks like Lamine Camara (Monaco) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

29' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Geronimo Rulli. Monaco earn a corner.
27' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
25' Timothy Weah (Marseille) tries to find Emerson, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
22' Marseille control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

20' Lukas Hradecky makes a brilliant save! Timothy Weah (Marseille) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
19' The foul by Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) was seen by Francois Letexier who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
18' A corner kick by Marseille is thwarted by the well prepared Lukas Hradecky (Monaco).

17' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes. The linesman makes the right call and Marseille will have a corner.

15' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
14' Good defending. Caio Henrique (Monaco) tries to find Takumi Minamino inside the box, but the pass is cut out. The linesman signals a throw-in for Monaco.
12' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
10' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Monaco, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
8' Great teamplay by Marseille as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
6' Michael Murillo (Marseille) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
6' Marseille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

6' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Lukas Hradecky. Marseille have been awarded a corner kick.
4' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) tries to find Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang, but he puts too much power on the pass. It's a throw-in for Monaco.
3' Emerson (Marseille) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
2' Vanderson (Monaco) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Marseille.
1' The first half has just begun.
1' The match will be delayed due to rioting fans.
Marseille will kick the game off.
Francois Letexier will officiate today.
